subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should this coordinated action-pin batch be approved after the direct Codex contract check and exact-head workflow matrix complete successfully?
rationale: The PR changes third-party code executed with repository credentials and publishing authority, and the protected security label requires an owner to accept that supply-chain boundary.

options.title: Verify and land the batch
options.body: Complete the Codex source inspection and required checks, then merge the consistent full-SHA refresh as one dependency-maintenance change.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, GitHub App token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing updates if any family needs independent proof or rollback.

options.title: Pause the refresh
